method.load: fresh python process per engine/voice; load_ms = process start (imports included) → model ready. Weights were already on disk and mostly in the OS file cache (not a cold-boot disk read).
method.synth: perf_counter around the engine call per sentence, sentences a→g in order in the same process; first sentence includes any first-call warm-up.
method.ttfa: first_chunk_ms if the engine streams (Piper: per sentence; Pocket: ~80 ms frames; XTTS: inference_stream 2nd pass; EMA/Antalia/Seslen: per sentence/clause; mlx stream=True), else synth_ms
method.rss: /usr/bin/time -l 'maximum resident set size' and 'peak memory footprint' for the whole process (MPS/Metal allocations show up in footprint, not RSS)
method.wer: whisper-cli 1.x, ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0, -l tr; digits → Turkish words on both sides, Turkish lowercase (I→ı, İ→i), suffix apostrophes dropped; word-level Levenshtein / reference words, weighted over the 7 sentences
method.numbers_ok: sentence c heard as containing 'seksen', 'yirmisi', 'otuzu' (whisper may write digits; they are spelled out first)
method.loudness: listening copies: ffmpeg loudnorm I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 (single pass) → mp3 VBR q2
method.flags: silencedetect -40 dB/0.25 s on raw wav: lead >0.5 s, trail >1 s, inner gap >0.8 s; syllable rate (vowels of the written text with numbers spelled / speech span) >8.5 or <3 syl/s; peak ≥ 0.999 (clipping)

failures.error: POST /v2/generate → HTTP 400 {"detail":"reference-mode cloning of audio requires zac-encoder.gguf and ssl-teacher.gguf; supply --zac-encoder and --ssl-teacher"}. Resolved: request speaker_mode "embedding" (the downloaded spk-encoder.gguf path). The first harness version also left 2 orphaned zonos3-server processes (SIGTERM hit /usr/bin/time, not the server); they were killed (pkill) and the script now signals the server PID directly.
